title: 第14章 强闯王陵，地宫门开
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
半个时辰后，卧龙山下。

    霍去病带着两百名绣衣使者，来到了那座刚刚建成不久的淮南王陵前。

    一座高大的封土堆，拔地而起，在阳光下，显得庄严肃穆。

    陵前，立着一块巨大的石碑，上面用篆文，书写着“大汉淮南厉王刘安之墓”。

    “厉”字，是朝廷根据刘安“误服丹药而亡”的行为，所赐予的谥号，意为“杀戮无辜，暴虐无亲”

    ，是一个不折不扣的恶谥。

    国相跟在后面，看着那块石碑，心如刀绞。

    他知道，这是皇帝，在向天下人，表明自己的态度。

    “就是这里了？”

    霍去病翻身下马，打量着眼前的陵墓。

    “回……回侯爷，正是此处。”

    国相声音干涩地回答。

    “入口在哪？”

    国相指了指封土堆前，一片被新土覆盖的区域。

    霍去病挥了挥手。

    “挖！”

    立刻，几十名身强力壮的绣衣使者，便拿出随身携带的工具，开始疯狂地挖掘起来。

    泥土翻飞。

    不到一炷香的功夫，深埋于地下的陵墓甬道入口，便暴露了出来。

    那是一扇，由整块巨石雕琢而成的石门。

    石门上，没有任何多余的装饰，只有厚重、古朴的气息。

    “撞开它！”

    霍去病毫不犹豫地命令道。

    几名绣衣使者，立刻找来一根巨大的圆木，充当撞木，狠狠地朝着石门撞去。

    “轰！”

    一声巨响，石门纹丝不动。

    反而那几个撞门的绣衣使者，被震得虎口发麻，连连后退。

    “有点意思。”

    霍去病眉头一挑。

    他走上前，伸出手，触摸了一下那冰冷的石门。

    入手的感觉，坚硬无比，远超普通的岩石。

    “继续撞！”

    这一次，十几个绣衣使者，合力抬起撞木，用尽全身力气，再次撞了上去。

    “轰！”

    “轰！”

    “轰！”

    接连数次撞击，石门依旧岿然不动。
content_en:
Half an hour later, at the foot of Wolong Mountain.

    Huo Qubing led two hundred embroidered messengers to the Huainan royal mausoleum that had just been built.

    A tall mound of sealed earth rises from the ground, looking solemn and solemn in the sun.

    In front of the mausoleum, there is a huge stone tablet with the words "Tomb of Liu An, King Li of Huainan, Han Dynasty" written in seal script.

    The word "Li" is the posthumous title given by the imperial court based on Liu An's behavior of "accidentally taking elixirs and dying", which means "killing innocents, tyrannizing without relatives"

    , is an out-and-out evil posthumous title.

    The Prime Minister followed behind, looking at the stone tablet with his heart pounding.

    He knew that this was the emperor, expressing his attitude to the people of the world.

    "Is this here?"

    Huo Qubing got off his horse and looked at the mausoleum in front of him.

    "Go back...back to Lord Marquis, right here."

    The Prime Minister replied in a dry voice.

    "Where is the entrance?"

    The Prime Minister pointed to an area covered with new soil in front of the mound.

    Huo Qubing waved his hand.

    "Dig!"

    Immediately, dozens of strong embroidered messengers took out the tools they carried and started digging frantically.

    Dirt flew.

    In less than a stick of incense, the entrance to the mausoleum corridor buried deep in the ground was exposed.

    It was a stone door carved from a single boulder.

    There are no unnecessary decorations on the stone door, only a heavy and simple atmosphere.

    "Bump it away!"

    Huo Qubing ordered without hesitation.

    Several messengers in embroidered clothes immediately found a huge log and used it as a bumper to hit the stone door hard.

    "Boom!"

    There was a loud noise, and the stone door didn't move at all.

    On the contrary, the few embroidered messengers who bumped into the door were shocked to the point of numbness and retreated continuously.

    "It's interesting."

    Huo Qubing raised his eyebrows.

    He stepped forward, stretched out his hand, and touched the cold stone door.

    It feels extremely hard when you hold it, far beyond ordinary rocks.

    "Keep banging!"

    This time, more than a dozen embroidered messengers worked together to lift the bumper and hit it again with all their strength.

    "Boom!"

    "Boom!"

    "Boom!"

    After being struck several times in succession, the stone door remained motionless.
title_en: Chapter 14 Breaking into the royal tomb, the underground palace door opens
